description: This file defines the Starboard Event system, including event types, data structures, callback types, and functions for handling system events in a platform-agnostic way. It manages application lifecycle events such as start, focus, blur, conceal, freeze, unfreeze, stop, and input events, as well as system notifications like network changes and accessibility settings.

methods.name: SbEventIsIdValid
methods.description: Inline function to check if an SbEventId handle is valid (not equal to invalid ID).

methods.name: SbRunStarboardMain
methods.description: Starts the main event loop with application-specific arguments and callback.

methods.name: SbEventHandle
methods.description: Main entry point for handling incoming system events; must be implemented by the application.

methods.name: SbEventSchedule
methods.description: Schedules a callback to be invoked in the main event loop after an optional delay.

methods.name: SbEventCancel
methods.description: Cancels a scheduled event by its ID if it has not yet been executed.
